dct_description_sm:
Polygon data representing the extent of the Significant Ground Water Recharge Areas (SGRAs) within the County of Essex as per the Clean Water Act. Includes a vulnerability score (High, Medium, Low) for each record.

Contains data provided by the Essex Region Conservation Authority (ERCA) and the Lower Thames Conservation Authority (LTVCA) for the purpose of inclusion into the County of Essex Official Plan (2014). Please contact the Conservation Authority for the most up to date information.
